svg.title: Map Outposts, moon
svg.desc: A ringed planet with an orbit broken at the upper right, where a moon rides: a body held at a distance by a path rather than a wire. Drawn in one ink on the budget-drs app icon's box and rules, for the page to paint in its text colour: solid, no strokes, and every gap at least 2.5 units, which is about 1.4 CSS pixels at 16.
